chapter.verse: Piter leh Johan in mihonpite kiangah thu a gen lai takun biakna innpi ukpa akipan siampite leh Saddusi mite hong pai uh a,
sawltakte in mite kiangah thu a hilh uh a, Zeisu hangin sihna pan thawhkikna thu a hilh manunah a lungmang uh hi.
Amaute a mat khit uh ciangin nitak ahih maninah, a zingsang dongin thong sungah a khum uh hi.
Ahih hangin thuhilhna a za mi tampite in um uh a, pasal teng tulnga bang a pha uh hi.
A zingsang ciangin amaute ukte, laitheite, siampi ukpa Annas, Kai-afas, Johan Alekzander akipan siampi ukpa’ suante khempeuh tawh Jerusalem khua-ah a kikhawm uh hi.
Amaute laizangah sawltakte ding sak uh a, “Note in bang vangliatna tawh, a kua min tawh, hih na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Tua lai takin Piter in Kha Siangtho tawh kidim a,
“Makaite leh upate aw, a zawngkhal mi khat tungah noptuamna pia a, ama cinatna bangci dam hiam ci-in note in tuni-in nong dot uh leh,

note in singlamteh tungah na thah khit uh ciangin, Pasian in sihna pan a thawhkik sak Nazareth mi Zeisu’ min tawh hih pa in note mai-ah cidamin a ding hi cih, note akipan Israel mi khempeuh in thei ta un.
Tua Topa in innlam note in na paih uh, a nung cianga kiukawi bul a suakkik suang ahi hi.

Tua mi simloh midang tungah gupna thu a om kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ama min simloh eite’ gupna ngah nadingin hong kipia mindang khat beek van nuai mite lakah a om kei hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Amaute in Piter leh Johan’ han’na mu uh a, lai siam lo, pilna hau lo ahih lam uh a theih uh ciangin lamdang a sa uh a, Zeisu tawh a omkhawm ngei zo uh hi ci-in a phawk uh hi.
Cidamna a ngahpa in amaute tawh ding khawma om a muh uh ciangin nial nading a mu zo kei uh hi.
Sawltakte vaihawmna pan a paikhiat ding uh thu a piak khit uh ciangin,
“Hih mite tungah bang i ci hih ding hiam? Amaute tung tawnin nalamdang lian a kilak zo hi ci-in Jerusalem khua mi khempeuh in a thei uh a, eite in i nial zo kei hi.
Ahih hangin mite lakah a kizelh semsem loh nadingin tu nung ciangin tua min tawh kuama kiangah thu hilh nawn lo dingin amaute tawngin thu pia ni,” ci-in khat le khat a kikum uh hi.
Tua ciangin sawltakte sam kik uh a, ‘Zeisu’ min tawh thu gen nawn peuhmah lo ding leh thu hilh nawn peuhmah lo dingin a kham uh hi.
Piter leh Johan in, “Topa’ thu sangin note’ thu ngaih ding Pasian mai-ah a kilawm zaw hiam, kilawm lo zaw hiam cih note in thu na khen ta un.
Kote ka hih uh leh, ka muhsa uh, ka theihsa uh thute gen loin ka om thei kei ding uh hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi.

Amaute in mihonpi hangin Piter leh Johan mawhna daan piak na’ng thu a ngah loh uh ciangin, khatvei a tawn’ kik khit uh ciangin a khah uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, hih bawlna thu hangin mi khempeuh in Pasian’ min a phat uh hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, hih cidamna a ngah nalamdang bawlna a ngahpa in kum sawmli val a pha zo mi ahi hi.
Sawltakte a kikhah khit uh ciangin amau mipawlte kiangah a pai uh a, siampi liante leh upate in amau kiangah a genna khempeuh a zasak uh hi.
Tua mite in a zak uh ciangin lungsim kikhatin, Pasian kiangah kiko-in, “Vantung leh leitung, tuipi leh tuipi sungah a om khempeuh a Bawlpa, Topa aw,
‘Gentailte in bang hangin a gamlum uh hiam? Mihonpite in bang hangin a mawkna-in a hanciam uh hiam?
‘Topa leh ama Khazih do dingin Leitung kumpite ding uh a, Gam-ukte in a kikhawm uh hi,’ci-in Kha Siangtho tawh nang in ka pa uh David’ kamin na cih mah bangin,
hih khua sungah Herod leh Pontias Pilat in Gentailte leh Israelte tawh nangmah na khut leh na ciamtehna in hong piang ding thu a piakkholh bangin,
sathau na nilhsa na Sila siangtho Zeisu tungah hih ding a kikhawm takpi uh hi.
Tu-in Topa aw, amau tawn’na thu na ciamteh in la, cinatna a damsak nadingin na khut na zan lai takin na silate in,
lau loin na thu a gen na’ngun a siangtho Sila Zeisu’ min tawh lim leh nalamdang a kibawl theih na’ngin hong hehpih in,” ci-in thu a ngen uh hi.
Tua thu a nget khit uh ciangin a kikhopna mun uh liing a, amaute khempeuh Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin Pasian’ thu hang takin a gen uh hi.
Thu-um mite in a lungsim leh a ngaihsut uh kikhat a, kuamah in ama neihsa khatpeuh peuh pen ama’ aa tuamin ngaihsun loin, a neih khempeuh uh a neikhawm uh hi.
Sawltakte in Topa Zeisu’ thawhkikna thu vangliatna tawh teci a pang uh a, amaute khempeuh in hehpihna thupha tampi a ngah uh hi.
Amaute lakah mizawng khat beek a om kei uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, inn ahi zongin, lo ahi zongin, a neih khempeuh uh a zuak khit uh ciangin a ngah a mante,
Sawltakte’ khe mai-ah koih uh a, mikim in a sapna tawh kituakin a vekpi-un a hawm ciat uh hi.
Josef kici, “Hehnem’ Ta” cihnopna ahi sawltakte in Barnabas min a phuah thak uh,
Levi pawl, Saipras mi khat in lo nei a, a zuak khit ciangin a dangka ngah teng hong paipih a, sawltakte’ khe kiangah a koih hi.
